title: IntegrationScenarioRecord
description: A registry record describing a real-world integration involving one or more LYRASIS Community Supported Technologies (CSTs). Enums under $defs are copied from registry/vocabularies.yaml by scripts/sync_vocabularies.py; edit that file instead.

id.description: System-generated UUID. Stable and permanent once assigned, and must match the filename (registry/scenarios/{id}.yaml).

title.description: Short, descriptive name for the integration, e.g. 'ArchivesSpace digital object linking to DSpace via REST API'.

source_system.description: The system(s) where the integration originates or is initiated.

target_system.description: The system(s) that receive data or expose endpoints consumed by the integration.

status.description: Active: in use at the submitting institution. Experimental: proof of concept. Deprecated: was active, no longer maintained. Retired and Recalled records are excluded from the public index.

description.description: What the integration does, the problem it solves, and key implementation decisions. Markdown supported.

submitted_by.description: Institution name of the submitter, optionally with a contact name.

prerequisites.description: Software versions, permissions, configurations, or third-party tools required before the integration can be replicated.

configuration_notes.description: Practical notes for replication: key configuration parameters, known gotchas, institution-specific decisions. Markdown supported.

code_repository_url.description: Public code repository containing implementation code, scripts, or plugins.

documentation_url.description: External documentation, wiki page, or technical write-up.

related_spec_url.description: Formal technical specification (e.g. a LYRASIS Interoperability Project spec) that this implementation corresponds to.

related_scenario_ids.description: IDs of other registry records that this scenario builds on, extends, or is related to.

source_system_profile.description: Link to an IOI InfraFinder, COAR IRD, or other profile of the source system.

target_system_profile.description: Link to an IOI InfraFinder, COAR IRD, or other profile of the target system.

min_system_versions.description: Minimum versions of the source/target systems tested, e.g. ['ArchivesSpace 3.4', 'DSpace 7.3'].

def_system_versions.description: Main versions of the source/target systems tested, e.g. ['ArchivesSpace 3.5', 'DSpace 9.0'].

last_verified_date.description: Date the implementer last confirmed the integration was still operational.

github_id.description: GitHub username to contact with follow-up questions.

license.description: SPDX license identifier or expression for the configuration notes and linked code, e.g. CC-BY-4.0, MIT, 'MIT OR Apache-2.0'.

tags.description: Free-text keywords for discovery, e.g. 'digitization workflow', 'finding aid'.

updated_date.description: System-generated timestamp of the most recent edit.

edited_by.description: Name or username of the person who made the most recent edit.

record_url.description: System-controlled canonical URL for this record (base URL + id).

flagged.description: System-controlled. Set by a registry administrator when a record is under review for accuracy or policy issues.
